verdict.rationale: Neon documents self-serve 'Instant restore' via branch-based point-in-time recovery (neon-docs-8/29) and its continuous WAL storage architecture (neon-gh-5), and the MCP tool surface exposes snapshot create/restore/schedule tools (neon-supp-mcp-tool-surface), suggesting some backup scheduling capability. However there's no dedicated docs page showing a founder-facing backup schedule UI/config (retention windows, frequency settings) distinct from continuous point-in-time recovery — Neon's model is largely continuous rather than a visible/configurable schedule. Missing for 10: a documented backup-schedule dashboard/settings page, explicit retention/frequency configuration options, and independent confirmation that restores work reliably in practice.
